messages:
maria (Marketing): OK team — quick sync on the OSS "Sample Packs" tutorial set + companion webinar. Need decisions on launch post, benchmark narrative, and where inbound signups route.
ben (DevRel): Love the name. quick Q: are we demoing Dedicated performance or hosted numbers in the benchmarks?
mar ia (Marketing): leaning hosted numbers for accessibility, but include a small Dedicated appendix for enterprise callouts. keep the main narrative about dev velocity and cost/latency tradeoffs.
ben (DevRel): makes sense. i'll craft a short benchmark blurb comparing latency per token for the sample models. will wire in the metric we'd used in the refkit (p50/p95, tokens/sec).
sam (Product): +1. also want a one-liner about guaranteed routing + fallback behavior — important for the webinar demo.
nora (Eng): i can throw together a reproducible script for the tutorial that runs locally and shows prefix caching gains. will format as `bash` + a tiny snippet.
ben (DevRel): perfect — can you keep the script <150 lines? we want copy/paste friendly.
maria (Marketing): timeline: draft post + tutorial set by Tues (1837720000), webinar slide deck by Thurs, announce Wed morning. Is that doable?
ben (DevRel): Tues draft seems tight but ok. i can take the benchmark narrative + one tutorial.
sam (Product): i'll own the webinar demo flow and the fallback lines.
nora (Eng): i’ll push the script to github and add a short README with expected outputs. link will be in the post.
maria (Marketing): inbound routing — ops-bot, can we route signups for the webinar to the growth queue, but tag enterprise leads for sales followup?
ops-bot: AUTOROUTE: received rule request. Proposed mapping:
- webinar signups with company_size > 100 -> sales-enterprise
- otherwise -> growth-inbound
Confirm to apply? :robot_face:
ben (DevRel): add a devrel-tag for signups that opt into SDK beta. small checkbox in form.
maria (Marketing): good call. UX for form: fields = name, email, company, company_size (select), use_case (textarea), checkbox "SDK beta opt-in".
sam (Product): include hidden field `utm_campaign=samplepacks-launch` so analytics picks it up.
nora (Eng): sample output from the script i’ll include in the tutorial README:
```
$ python run_demo.py --model redwood-small --input "Summarize"
Latency p50: 45ms
Tokens/sec: 210
Cache hit: true
```
maria (Marketing): messaging iteration — two variants for the post intro: A) "Build faster with curated model packs and reproducible benchmarks" B) "Open sample packs to ship LLM features with predictable cost and latency" Which resonates more?
ben (DevRel): i vote B. speaks to predictability which is our differentiator. :thumbsup:
sam (Product): A is more dev-first. maybe test both in subject lines.
maria (Marketing): ok split-test subject lines in the announcement email. ben — can you draft the short benchmark sidebar (3 bullets + 1 chart suggestion)?
ben (DevRel): will do. chart idea: tokens/sec vs model variant, and a tiny table for p50/p95.
maria (Marketing): finalize owner list: marketing = maria, devrel = ben, product/demo = sam, engineering artifacts = nora. ops to apply routing rule once we confirm fields.
ops-bot: noted. awaiting `apply` command.
maria (Marketing): i'll queue a draft by EOD today and tag you all. if we hit blockers, ping here. thanks! :sparkles:
